  html_document:
    self_contained: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.show = "show")
```

```{r config-and-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)

# Load config and functions
source(here("config.R"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "barchart_cat_var_func.r"))

# Output directory
hist_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT, "6_Histograms")
dir.create(hist_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(file.path(CLEAN_DATA, "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r restrict-sample}
# Keep only labgroupids with both BL and EL data, then keep the BL row.
df_sample <- df %>%
  group_by(labgroupid) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

df_bl <- df_sample %>% filter(survey == "BL")
```

# SPARK Awareness

```{r awareness}
make_barchart(
  df             = df_bl,
  variable       = "spark_awareness",
  category_order = c("No", "Not sure", "Yes"),
  output_file    = "bar_spark_awareness.pdf",
  output_dir     = hist_dir
)
```
```{r awareness-when}
make_barchart(
  df             = df_bl,
  variable       = "spark_awareness_when",
  category_order = c(
    "Within the last 2 months", "2-6 months ago", 
    "6-12 months ago", "More than 1 year ago"),
  output_file    = "bar_spark_awareness_when.pdf",
  output_dir     = hist_dir
)
```

# Checklist Discussion

```{r checklist-discussion}
discussion_order <- c(
  "Not at all", "A little", "A moderate amount", "Quite a lot", "A great deal"
)

make_barchart(
  df             = df_bl,
  variable       = "checklist_discussion",
  category_order = discussion_order,
  output_file    = "bar_checklist_discussion.pdf",
  output_dir     = hist_dir
)
```

Collapsed to 3 categories ("A moderate amount", "Quite a lot", and "A great deal"
merged into one), styled to match `3_1_hist_electricity_truncated.rmd`'s ungrouped
("overall") panels - bluish-green fill, larger serif font, no axis ticks - via
`make_barchart()`'s style-override parameters.

```{r checklist-discussion-collapsed}
df_bl <- df_bl %>%
  mutate(checklist_discussion_collapsed = case_when(
    checklist_discussion %in% c("A moderate amount", "Quite a lot", "A great deal") ~
      "A moderate amount to a great deal",
    TRUE ~ checklist_discussion
  ))

discussion_order_collapsed <- c(
  "Not at all", "A little", "A moderate amount to a great deal"
)

make_barchart(
  df                = df_bl,
  variable          = "checklist_discussion_collapsed",
  category_order    = discussion_order_collapsed,
  output_file       = "bar_checklist_discussion_collapsed.pdf",
  output_dir        = hist_dir,
  font_family       = "serif",
  bar_colour        = "#009E73",
  alpha             = 0.6,
  outline_alpha     = 1,
  linewidth         = 0.7,
  base_size         = 16,
  label_size        = 4.6,
  label_vjust       = -0.6,
  show_ticks        = FALSE,
  axis_text_x_size  = 12.5,
  axis_text_y_size  = 15,
  axis_title_y_size = 17,
  y_expand          = 0.15,
  width             = 7,
  height            = 4.5
)
```
